description: Tune pathfinder engine parameters (thinking budget per search/tick, search radius, and path-shortcut / line-of-sight placement behaviour). Returns the resulting values.

LOSWhenPlacingBlocks.description: Require line of sight when placing scaffolding

enablePathShortcut.description: Skip redundant nodes for smoother paths

searchRadius.description: Limit the search radius in blocks (-1 = unlimited)

thinkTimeout.description: Max ms for a full path search

tickTimeout.description: Max ms of thinking per tick (<=50)

name: configure_pathfinder
